content.title: Continuous Objective Defense | Complementary Role Swaps and Threat-Ring Escalation
content.summary: Keep one objective spatially recoverable through a continuous camera path while a mobile precision defender and a heavy space-control defender exchange foreground priority through direction, occlusion and action consequences. Track one tool effect to impact, compress the threat ring and end with both roles plus the objective state visible.

quick_start.input_format: recoverable glowing objective + adult mobile precision defender and adult heavy space-control defender + continuous path with at least three causal attention handoffs + one tool effect tracked from launch to impact + outer-ring to close-intrusion to environmental-state escalation + both defenders and objective state in the ending
quick_start.recommended_input: A lunar greenhouse's amber seed core is defended by an adult cable scout and a heavy adult pressure engineer against spore drones. Match a cable swing, shield occlusion and marker-dart impact across one continuous path, let the drone ring breach close range, then regroup both defenders as clean-air vents push a blue atmosphere outward and the core stays stable.
required_anchors: Keep one objective's position and visual signature recoverable through the entire continuous path.
Use one mobile precision defender and one heavy space-control defender with distinct functions.
Track at least one projectile or tool effect from launch to visible impact.
Escalate the threat ring and finish with both roles plus the objective state visible.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Keep one objective spatially recoverable through a continuous camera path while a mobile precision defender and a heavy space-control defender exchange foreground priority through direction, occlusion and action consequences. Track one tool effect to impact, compress the threat ring and end with both roles plus the objective state visible.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Choose one original objective with a unique light or material signature and keep its location recoverable throughout one continuous camera path. Use two clearly different adult defender roles: one mobile precision role and one heavy space-control role. Transfer foreground priority at least three times through matched direction, occlusion or direct action consequence; track at least one projectile or tool effect from launch to impact. Escalate threat topology from a readable outer ring to close intrusion and then to an environmental state change. End with both defenders regrouped at the objective and show whether the objective remains stable, changes or fails. The reusable mechanism is fixed-objective continuous geography, role-swap causality and threat-ring escalation—not the source crystal, characters, creatures, weapons, armor, exact actions, camera route, style, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Keep one objective's position and visual signature recoverable through the entire continuous path.
invariants.purpose: Prevents a long action take from losing its strategic center.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the objective disappears without spatial cues, the defense becomes generic combat.

invariants.rule: Use one mobile precision defender and one heavy space-control defender with distinct functions.
invariants.purpose: Allows meaningful role swaps instead of interchangeable action bodies.
invariants.ablation_failure: Identical roles make foreground transfers decorative.

invariants.rule: Transfer attention at least three times through matched direction, occlusion or direct action consequence.
invariants.purpose: Maintains causal continuity without hard cuts.
invariants.ablation_failure: Arbitrary camera swings break the single-event chain.

invariants.rule: Track at least one projectile or tool effect from launch to visible impact.
invariants.purpose: Provides a verifiable action-result bridge inside the moving shot.
invariants.ablation_failure: Impacts without launches or launches without outcomes weaken causality.

invariants.rule: Escalate the threat ring and finish with both roles plus the objective state visible.
invariants.purpose: Closes topology, teamwork and consequence together.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending on a random attacker or empty effect leaves the defense unresolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source small armored gunner, heavy ally, faces, bodies, armor, weapons and exact character scale
the source green crystal, forest arena, mutant creatures, enemy anatomy and threat designs
the source leaps, shots, projectile, impacts, dodges, punches, crowding and exact combat choreography
the source one-take camera route, lens behavior, palette, animation treatment and 30-second rhythm
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.5 and Video Studio claims, reference images, watermark and branding
